run_health_check: run an HTTP/2 health check against a gRPC server on a given host and port
run_health_check_custom_host: run an HTTP/2 health check against a gRPC server on a custom host and port
test_grpc_server_alive: test if a gRPC server is live by checking for the grpc-encoding header
review_health_check_logic: review the python module to verify the grpc-encoding header check logic
refactor_health_check: refactor the python health check script to support additional gRPC endpoints
